other_conditions: Applicant must be a native of Madhya Pradesh belonging to a minority community
Must have secured at least 50% marks in the last qualifying examination
Eligibility category noted in source: minority
benefits_summary: Hostel students receive a maintenance allowance of ₹1,000 per month (for 10 months) and non‑hostel students ₹500 per month (for 10 months), plus reimbursement of actual course fees up to ₹20,000.
